body: did you know: taylor wrote "fifteen" backwards from one line -- "abigail gave everything she had to a boy who changed his mind." it was her best friend's real heartbreak, so she played abigail the song and asked first. abigail said yes, and she's in the video as herself.
why: X-native (text-only) version of the Fearless 'Fifteen' did-you-know, keeping X active a second day. Same sourced facts as the IG sibling, trimmed to the write-it-backwards line, asking Abigail first, and Abigail appearing in the video. Every claim traces to the Vault Fearless 'Fifteen, written for her best friend Abigail' item (Wikipedia/Songfacts). Friendship/song lore only, outside every blocklist topic.
